title: Cost-Aware Post-Hoc Deferral Under Calibration and Shift: An Environmental AI Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.09235v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Choosing a deferral policy for a frozen classifier requires more than ranking uncertain cases: confidence may be miscalibrated, errors have unequal costs, reviewers can err, and deployment data can leave calibration support. We study these interactions through EcoTrust, a post-hoc framework that compares automatic action with review using a six-group error-risk estimator, class-asymmetric costs, reviewer accuracy, and an optional support gate. On a Columbia River thermal-stress testbed, the learned estimator improves error-ranking area under the receiver operating characteristic curve from 0.869 to 0.889, but Chow's confidence rule has lower in-distribution cost (0.416 versus 0.567 per day). Across 12 off-the-shelf backends, learned risk and a calibration-matched, class-aware confidence estimator each beat raw Chow on six; a paired year-block bootstrap does not resolve their mean cost difference. translated_title: 校准与分布偏移下的成本感知后验弃权：一个环境AI案例研究
translated_abstract: 为冻结分类器选择弃权策略所需的不仅仅是对不确定样本进行排序：置信度可能校准不佳，错误具有不相等的代价，审核人员也可能犯错，且部署数据可能偏离校准的支持范围。我们通过EcoTrust研究这些因素之间的交互作用，EcoTrust是一个后验框架，它使用六组错误风险估计器、类别不对称代价、审核员准确率以及可选的支持门控来比较自动决策与人工审核。在哥伦比亚河热胁迫测试平台上，学习到的估计器将错误排序的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）从0.869提升至0.889，但Chow置信度规则在分布内的代价更低（每天0.416对0.567）。在12个现成后端模型中，学习到的风险估计器与校准匹配的类别感知置信度估计器各有六个优于原始Chow规则；配对的年度块自助法无法判定二者平均代价差异的显著性。在向十个河流站点的迁移实验中，该框架进一步评估了分布偏移下的弃权决策表现。
tldr: 本文提出EcoTrust后验弃权框架，综合考虑置信度校准误差、类别不对称代价、审核员出错与分布偏移，并在环境AI案例中揭示学习式风险估计器虽能提升错误排序能力，但其代价未必优于简单的Chow置信度规则。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EcoTrust, a post-hoc deferral framework that jointly accounts for miscalibrated confidence, class-asymmetric costs, reviewer errors, and distribution shift, showing in an environmental AI case study that learned risk estimators improve error ranking but do not always outperform the simple Chow confidence rule in cost.
